name: Reusable scrapbook-style teen companion check-in scene
acceptanceCriteria: The canonical teen Room exposes a scrapbook check-in launcher in a dedicated footer below the illustrated Room canvas, so it does not cover or intercept existing Room hotspots.
One reusable companion scene renders Suhana, Sy, Cloud, or Night with warm-white paper, masking tape, doodles, a Polaroid-style frame, cozy dark-mode room art, and time-of-day-aware atmosphere.

Visible peer companion copy uses Suhana, Sy, Cloud, and Night while raylene and rylane remain compatibility-only internal identifiers; Ja remains a distinct continuity presence and is not relabeled Oracle on this surface.
The scene refreshes its time phase while mounted and on app-resume, and Rain Room explicitly preserves the rain phase.
The first approved Sy evening composition keeps the note 'you made it through today.' and a Bip-with-companion CTA; that CTA sets the selected companion before handing off to existing Pages.
This UI slice adds no Supabase, Worker, auth, telemetry, parent-visibility, journal-read, microphone, or private-data boundary.
